title: Orsen and the Veil
author: Paloma Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Halloran, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
